source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original migration documents the cancellation URL listener as optional and the UI caller passes null in its new listener slot, but the original C++ receiver rejects null before retrieving the NNTP service. The unit test supplies a PromiseUrlListener, so that path does not cover the UI's null-listener case. At the fixed accepted revision the listener guard is absent. This records the original mismatch and later source state without claiming a current or reproduced cancellation failure.
title: The original news-cancel listener guard disagreed with its optional caller
